CanonicalKeywords.maps_to: is_playable = False, eternal = True, innate = True, is_ethereal = True (folly.py:25-28)
CanonicalKeywords.rationale: All FOUR keywords ported: `{ Unplayable, Eternal, Innate, Ethereal }` (Folly.cs:12-18) == the four class attributes. The most keyword-dense card in the pool so far, and every one is present -- including Innate, which makes Folly start in the opening hand, and Ethereal, which then exhausts it. As CANONICAL keywords rather than upgrade-added ones they carry no downgrade-rebuild hazard.

ctor.issue: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges -- `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to 0 on both sides. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses.

OnPlay.rationale: Folly.cs declares no OnPlay and the card is Unplayable; the sim's abstract method is a `pass`.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (folly.py:30), which has no counterpart in Folly.cs
guards.rationale: Inert: the flag only steers `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference (cmds.py:44-50) and Folly deals no damage.
